_note: direct: feeds proven working in the sibling Welcome to Your Galaxy repos.
Nothing was invented — an untested feed URL reports itself unreachable on
every harvest and quietly makes the coverage figure a lie.
gnews: Google News locale searches. The harvester builds the URL from
hl / gl / ceid. Twenty-four queries rotate across 46 locales so all ten of
the named forms are covered rather than one repeated.
events: subject searches for the treaty bodies, monitors and recurring
publications that have no verified feed here.
official  courts, treaty bodies, equality commissions, UN bodies
press     general news across the locales
Worth adding, with URLs you have opened: Minority Rights Group, Equal Rights
Trust, IDA (disability), Dalit rights organisations, national equality bodies.
